decisions.reason: The Abendbrotkäse was publicly launched on the home page as a flagship of the cheese direction, so management will keep justifying it and treat its absence from the website in 2020–2021 as a temporary drop in visibility rather than failure.
The semi-hard wheel sits close to the core assortment and costs little to keep, so even with no recent website presence management sees no pressing reason to give up the investment in it.
As a multi-variant line it embodies substantial sunk investment and shelf commitment, which favours persisting, perhaps with a trimmed set of variants, over full withdrawal.

The washed-rind soft cheese is the most niche and least promoted item and has not been visible since 2018, but as part of the cheese range management still leans toward keeping it while blaming weak results on the market.
